channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Lindsey Vonn facing long recovery after ‘complex’ Olympic leg fracture
item.description: MILAN >> Lindsey Vonn could return to elite ski racing within a year after her displaced tibia fracture, orthopaedic specialists say, but age and mental resilience will play a key role in whether the former Olympic champion can come back at the highest level.

item.title: E-bicyclist injured in collision on Farrington Highway in Kapolei
item.description: A 20-year-old man is in critical condition after he was hit by a vehicle while riding an electric bicycle this morning near the intersection of Farrington Highway and Hikukahi Street in East Kapolei.

item.title: Box jellyfish advisory issued for Ala Moana, Waikiki, Maili beaches
item.description: A box jellyfish advisory has been issued this morning for Ala Moana Beach Park and Waikiki. An alert was also issued at about 12:40 p.m. today for Maili.

item.title: Canada’s Carney: Bridge dispute with Trump ‘will be settled’
item.description: OTTAWA/WASHINGTON >> Canada and the United States will resolve the issue of a $4.7 billion bridge connecting Detroit and Windsor, Ontario, that President Donald Trump is unhappy about, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney told reporters today

item.title: Dow hits third straight record close as retail sales stall
item.description: The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq closed lower today while the Dow edged up to its third record close in a row, as investors digested disappointing retail sales figures and waited for a key labor market report.

item.title: Hawaii’s Kiner-Falefa discusses play in 9th inning of World Series’ Game 7
item.description: FORT MYERS, Fla. >> Four months after he was thrown out at the plate in the bottom of the ninth in Game 7 of the 2025 World Series, Isiah Kiner-Falefa explained his perspective on a play many thought cost the Toronto Blue Jays the championship.

item.title: FBI files: Trump told police chief ‘everyone’ knew about Epstein
item.description: A newly uncovered FBI interview raised new questions about President Donald Trump’s assertion he knew nothing about convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein’s crimes, while Trump’s commerce secretary, Howard Lutnick, faced a barrage of questions from lawmakers today about his own ties to the financier.

item.title: Gabbard’s 2020 election claims put her back in favor with Trump
item.description: WASHINGTON >> In late January, Tulsi Gabbard, the director of national intelligence, was leading a meeting on Syria in the Situation Room, when President Donald Trump abruptly changed course by reminding her of an earlier chat on a subject he regarded as even more urgent.

item.title: ICE is cracking down on people who follow them in their cars
item.description: WASHINGTON >> Becky Ringstrom was heading home after following federal immigration officers in her gray Kia SUV in suburban Minneapolis when she was suddenly boxed in by unmarked vehicles. At least a half-dozen masked agents jumped out to arrest her, one knocking on her windshield with a metal object as if threatening to use it to break her window.

item.title: High-rise building fire on Hobron Lane put out
item.description: A high-rise building fire in an 11th-floor unit at 400 Hobron Lane in Waikiki was extinguished Tuesday afternoon with no injuries reported.
